subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in agents.defaults/per-agent iterationBudget-style public config for hard tool-calling round limits, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485 be the implementation path?
rationale: This adds public config and runtime stop semantics, and AGENTS.md/VISION.md make config/default surfaces and operator-controlled safety knobs maintainer product decisions rather than automatic repair work.

options.title: Sponsor the open iteration-budget path
options.body: Resolve the conflicting PR, keep the feature opt-in, and require docs/tests for default compatibility, unsupported harness behavior, and exhaustion output.

options.title: Narrow to existing loop-detection semantics
options.body: Reject new public budget config for now and instead tune tools.loopDetection, timeouts, or docs around the existing guardrails.

options.title: Defer as broader guardrails work
options.body: Leave this issue as canonical until a wider resource-budget design covers tool calls, cost, rate limits, and channel-specific policy together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the open iteration-budget path
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicting PR, keep the feature opt-in, and require docs/tests for default compatibility, unsupported harness behavior, and exhaustion output.
